card.title: IPhone 6 Plus Touch Disease

claims.statement: iPhone 6 Plus 'touch disease' is a disconnection of touch IC U2402.
Remove U2402 and jumper pad M1 (commonly breaks) even if intact, then refit; removing underfill on nearby parts first avoids breaking front camera or earpiece connections.

procedure: Remove underfill near the work area.
Remove U2402 with limited heat (CPU on reverse).
Refit reballed or new U2402; flex-test touch and check front camera/earpiece.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: Excess heat may disturb the CPU on the opposite side.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
